definitions.explanation: A device that measures and displays a quantity such as speed, distance, electricity usage, or gas consumption. From English 'meter'.
The fare meter in a taxi that calculates and displays the fare based on distance and time.

notes:
A loanword from English 'meter'. Used broadly for any measuring instrument or gauge. In taxi contexts, メーター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧ (literally 'to knock down the meter') means to start the meter running.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メーター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at the meter
- メーター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the meter
- メーター⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: the meter goes up (taxi fare)
- メーター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧: to start the taxi meter
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧メーター: electric meter
- ガスメーター: gas meter
- ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧メーター: speedometer
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧メーター: water meter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{計器|けいき}→計器：03946_keiki⟧: instrument, gauge — a more technical, formal term for measuring instruments
- ⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧: metre — the unit of length (not to be confused with メーター the measuring device)
